stemMd: Four samples J, K, L and M are processed one at a time. J is before K; L is after K; M is before J. Which sample must be third?
explanationMd: Combine the conditions into M before J before K before L. There is only one order satisfying all three, so K occupies the third position.

distractorRationale.a: The constraints form a complete chain.
distractorRationale.b: M must precede J, and J must precede K.
distractorRationale.c: M is constrained to precede the whole chain.
distractorRationale.d: L follows K and all others precede K.
